name: Aerovex
tagline: The autonomous inspection layer for infrastructure that cannot fail.
positioning: Aerovex turns raw drone flight into audit-ready defect intelligence — one platform for capture, analysis, and compliance across every asset you own.

hero.h1: See every flaw before it becomes a failure.
hero.sub: Aerovex flies, sees, and certifies your critical infrastructure autonomously — transforming millions of drone frames into a single defect ledger your engineers and regulators both trust.

features.title: Autonomous capture grids
features.description: Program a corridor, a substation, or a 400m stack once. Aerovex flies the mission repeatably, holding centimeter GPS lock so every inspection is comparable frame-to-frame.

features.title: Defect intelligence engine
features.description: Corrosion, spalling, hotspots, and vegetation encroachment are detected, ranked by severity, and geotagged to the exact asset component — no analyst scrubbing footage at 2x.

features.title: Audit-ready evidence chain
features.description: Every finding ships with raw imagery, flight metadata, and a timestamped signature, exporting straight into the compliance formats your regulators already demand.

features.title: Digital twin drift tracking
features.description: Compare this quarter's scan against the last. Aerovex surfaces millimeter changes in structures so degradation is caught as a trend, not a catastrophe.

features.title: Fleet orchestration
features.description: Coordinate hundreds of pilots and platforms across regions from one console, with airspace clearance, battery telemetry, and mission status in a single live view.

features.title: Engineering-grade API
features.description: Push findings into your CMMS, ERP, or asset registry the moment a drone lands. Work orders open themselves before the pilot has packed the case.

testimonials.quote: We inspected 1,200 transmission towers in a single season with a two-person team. Aerovex flagged three anchor-bolt failures our ground crews had walked past for years.
testimonials.name: Priya Ramachandran

testimonials.quote: The evidence chain is what sold our regulators. Every defect comes with proof no auditor can argue with. Our inspection cycle dropped from eleven weeks to nine days.
testimonials.name: Dennis Whitlock

testimonials.quote: Aerovex doesn't sell us footage — it sells us decisions. The severity ranking tells my planners exactly which of forty bridges gets crews on Monday.
testimonials.name: Sofia Bergstrom
